start: Workout plans page, signed in online as the owner, nothing set for today, the gym has at least one open workout plan

steps.action: Open Workout plans
must_not: A card that never finishes loading
The card shown when the gym is not online (it must be hidden)

steps.action: Tap 'Set today’s workout', then under 'Start from one of your plans (optional)' pick '<plan> · Day 1'
user_sees: Workout name, 'Kind of day' and the exercises filled from that plan day
must_not: The workout plan itself changed when this copy is edited
A closed plan offered in the list

steps.action: Type a line in 'Note for members (optional)' and tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: Row 'Today' with '<name> · N exercises · set by <name>'
must_not: The workout saved for the wrong day
Two workouts for one day
The sheet closing when the save failed

start: Workout of the day card with today's workout already set (the owner builds one from nothing for a later day)

steps.action: Tap '+ Plan another day'
user_sees: Sheet 'Workout of the day' with 'Day' on the next day that has no workout
'No exercises yet. Pick a plan above, or search below to add one.'
must_not: Today picked by default, so today's workout is replaced by mistake

steps.action: Type a workout name, pick the 'Kind of day', add exercises by search, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: A second row under today's, earliest day first
must_not: Today's workout changed
A day more than 7 days ahead accepted

start: Sheet 'Workout of the day' open as the owner

steps.action: Leave the name empty and tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: 'Give the workout a name, for example “Leg day”.'
must_not: The sheet closing
A nameless workout sent to members

steps.action: Type a name but add no exercise, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: The workout plans' own problem line in plain words (exact words not read)
must_not: An empty workout saved
The typed name lost

steps.action: Type a name longer than the limit, tap 'Save workout'
must_not: The name cut without a word

steps.action: Keep the sheet open past midnight India time with 'Day' on the old today, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: 'Pick today or a day in the next week.'
must_not: A workout saved for yesterday
The saved toast

start: Workout of the day card with a workout set for today and one for tomorrow

steps.action: On today's row tap 'Change', edit an exercise, tap 'Save workout'
user_sees: The row shows the new line and who set it
must_not: A second row for today
Members who already started keep a half-changed workout without notice

steps.action: Tap 'Change' on today's row and switch 'Day' to tomorrow
user_sees: 'This replaces “<tomorrow's name>”, already set for that day.'
must_not: Tomorrow's workout replaced with no warning line

steps.action: Close the sheet. On tomorrow's row tap 'Take it off'
must_not: The workout removed without the question

steps.action: Tap 'Take it off'
must_not: Members still shown the removed workout
The row gone from the screen when the server refused

start: A workout of the day saved by the owner; a member of the gym opens the MettleUp app

steps.action: Save today's workout with a note
user_sees: Row '<name> · N exercises · set by <name>' in the panel
must_not: The workout shown to another gym or another branch

steps.action: As a member of this gym, open the Workout tab
user_sees: 'Today at <gym>' with the workout, started with one tap
must_not: A member of another gym seeing it
Private staff details beyond the name of who set it
A member's own data sent back to the gym by opening it

steps.action: Sign in to the panel on this device only (not online) and open Workout plans
must_not: A card that saves only on this device while members see nothing
